Money Heist (La Casa de Papel) has one of the most iconic and highly regarded opening sequences in modern streaming, often cited by fans as a highlight of the series. From the first note of Cecilia Krull’s "My Life Is Going On," the vibe shifts. The intro involves breaking down its symbolic, artistic, and technical components, which emphasize themes of resistance, the color red, and anonymity. The intro sets the tone for a "Robin Hood" style rebellion against a capitalist system. The paper models aren't just art; they’re a literal map of The Professor’s obsession. As the camera glides through the blueprint of the Mint, you’re seeing the heist’s DNA before it even begins. It doesn't just start the show; it prepares you for the war.
